id.title: "Mengonsumsi 'makanan ini' mengurangi rasa gatal hingga 78% dan meningkatkan kelembapan kulit hin...
id.description:
Suplemen nutrisi dan pelembap mahal yang mengandung bahan khusus tidak banyak berpengaruh, tetapi...

Mungkinkah apa yang sebenarnya ada di meja makan kita adalah harta karun yang sesungguhnya?

Saya akan menjelaskan secara detail tentang identitas 'makanan ini' yang efektif dalam mengobati dermatitis atopik.

Anda mungkin pernah mendengar pepatah bahwa Anda perlu menjaga kesehatan usus agar kulit Anda membaik, bukan?

Ketika keseimbangan mikroorganisme di usus terganggu, penghalang usus melemah,

dan racun yang dilepaskan oleh bakteri meresap ke dalam aliran darah, menyebabkan peradangan di seluruh tubuh.

Itulah mengapa probiotik sangat penting dalam mengobati dermatitis atopik.

Kuncinya adalah probiotik mana yang harus dikonsumsi dan bagaimana caranya.

Dr. Park Chi-young, seorang spesialis penyakit kulit yang sulit diobati, dan Dr. Jung Dae-woong, yang telah mengatasi dermatitis atopik parah, akan berbagi

'Efek Luar Biasa dari Probiotik Berbasis Tanaman.'

Silakan tonton video ini dan ciptakan kulit yang cantik dan sehat! Obrolan Kulit Park Chi-young dan Jung Dae-woong (Diunggah setiap Kamis pukul 7 pagi)

- Direktur Park Chi-young dan Direktur Jung Dae-woong dari Klinik Pengobatan Korea Saengki

en-US.title: "Eating ‘this food’ reduced scratching by 78% and increased skin moisture by 164%? What is the id...
en-US.description:
Expensive nutritional supplements and moisturizers containing special ingredients didn't have much effect, but...

Could it be that what's actually on our dinner table is the real treasure?

I will tell you in detail about the identity of ‘this food’ that is effective in treating atopic dermatitis.

You’ve probably heard the saying that you need to keep your gut healthy for your skin to improve, right?

When the balance of microorganisms in the gut is disrupted, the intestinal barrier weakens,

and toxins released by bacteria seep into the bloodstream, causing inflammation throughout the body.

That is why probiotics are so important in treating atopic dermatitis.

The key is which probiotics to consume and how.

Dr. Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Dr. Jung Dae-woong, who overcame severe atopic dermatitis, will share

‘The Amazing Effects of Plant-Based Probiotics.’

id.description:
Saya disarankan untuk menjalani operasi untuk robekan rotator cuff, tetapi...

Apakah kondisinya membaik hanya dengan berolahraga?

Saya pernah mendengar bahwa dalam beberapa kasus, olahraga justru memperburuk robekan.

en-US.title: Recurring Genital Warts (Condyloma), Does ‘This Food’ Prevent Recurrence? The Key Diet for Boosti...
en-US.description:
What on earth should I eat to prevent the recurrence of genital warts (condyloma)?

Since recurrence is so common, patients ask this question very frequently.

You just need to follow 'two things'!

Genital warts, also known as condyloma, have a high recurrence rate even after treatment.

Current procedures such as laser therapy, cryotherapy, and electrocautery only physically remove visible lesions; they do not eliminate the virus itself.

It is the same principle as cutting off the stem of a weed without pulling it out by the roots.

Therefore, the key to preventing recurrence is ultimately 'immunity.'

The virus is fundamentally eliminated only when our body's immune cells are able to recognize and attack the virus-infected cells on their own.

That is why dietary therapy is crucial alongside treatments to improve immunity.

Refer to this video to learn 'the true identity of foods that prevent the recurrence of condyloma,' shared by Dr. Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Dr. Jung Dae-woong, who overcame severe atopic dermatitis.

Try to achieve beautiful and healthy skin! Park Chi-young and Jung Dae-woong's Skin Talk (Uploaded every Thursday at 7 AM)

- Director Park Chi-young and Director Jung Dae-woong of Saengki Korean Medicine Clinic

en-US.title: The excruciating pain of 'Benign Paroxysmal Vertigo'—follow along when you're in a hurry! Rehabil...
en-US.description:
Many people, regardless of age, suffer from ‘BPPV.’

In particular, BPPV causes significant discomfort by inducing sudden dizziness and nausea.

Check out the causes of BPPV and effective rehabilitation exercises!

Medically, BPPV is referred to as Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo.

Located in the vestibular system at the innermost part of the ear, there are small calcium carbonate crystals responsible for balance, known as otoliths.

When these otoliths dislodge from their proper position and flow into the semicircular canals, they trigger abnormal stimuli depending on head or body movements, which manifests as severe dizziness.

Therefore, the key to treating BPPV is returning the displaced otolith fragments to their original positions.

Refer to this video on ‘Exercises Good for BPPV’ taught by Physical Therapist Team Leader Sung Woo-kyung, and keep up the good work today!

Seong Woo-kyung’s Love for Physical Therapy

en-US.title: Are dead skin cells the skin's first line of defense? Don't forcibly rub off the dead skin cells!...
en-US.description:
If you suffer from skin conditions, you often experience significant stress due to dead skin cells.

This is because they cause the skin to flaky white, fall onto your clothes, and are visually bothersome.

I will explain why you shouldn't scrub away dead skin cells and what role they play in your skin.

You might think that if you just wipe away the unsightly dead skin cells rising to the surface, your skin will become clean.

However, there are actually many cases where the skin condition worsens after exfoliation.

Dead skin cells are not an enemy to be removed, but a protective barrier that safeguards the skin.

Dead skin cells are especially important when you have a skin condition.

Dr. Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Dr. Jung Dae-woong, who overcame severe atopic dermatitis, explain

the 'importance of dead skin cells.'

Please refer to this video and achieve beautiful, healthy skin! Park Chi-young and Jung Dae-woong's Skin Talk (Uploaded every Thursday at 7 AM)

- Director Park Chi-young and Director Jung Dae-woong of Saengki Korean Medicine Clinic

Saengki Korean Medicine Clinic http://www.saengki.com/

YouTube Saengki TV https://www.youtube.com/@saengki_TV

en-US.title: 6 Must-Follow Habits to Prevent Recurrence of Ringworm and Athlete's Foot - Park Chi-young, Jung ...
en-US.description:
Many people believe that fungal skin diseases like ringworm and athlete's foot are caused by not washing properly. However, the problem is often not the washing itself, but rather the way you wash or the care you take afterward. Check out the essential lifestyle management methods needed to prevent the recurrence of ringworm and athlete's foot!

Ringworm is a disease caused by dermatophytes, a type of fungus, that parasitize the stratum corneum of the skin. It is also called "ringworm" due to its characteristic ring-shaped lesions. It is a very common skin disease, with 20 to 25% of the world's population having experienced dermatophyte infection.

Ringworm is not a condition that is resolved with just a single application of ointment.

Research showed that while the recurrence rate was 22% for the group treated solely with medication, it dropped to 8% for the group that also incorporated lifestyle management. This highlights just how important lifestyle management methods are.

Refer to this video for the "6 Essential Lifestyle Management Methods for Ringworm" shared by Dr. Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Dr. Jung Dae-woong, who overcame severe atopic dermatitis, and achieve beautiful, healthy skin! Park Chi-young and Jung Dae-woong's Skin Talk (Uploaded every Thursday at 7 AM)

- Director Park Chi-young and Director Jung Dae-woong of Saengki Korean Medicine Clinic

en-US.title: If you absolutely can't find the time or the hassle to exercise? 5 Simple Bridge Exercises You Ca...
en-US.description:
No matter how good an exercise is, it is ineffective if it is difficult to follow or cannot be done consistently.

For those who are short on time due to a busy daily life, or those who find it bothersome and difficult to even move a finger,

If you follow along for just 5 minutes before bed, you can make your body firm and healthy.

The bridge exercise is the most basic posture for creating a beautiful back silhouette,

and allows you to stretch your upper body while simultaneously strengthening major muscles, including your core and glutes.

It revitalizes your lower body, which is exhausted from the day,

and can also help relieve insomnia and stress.

The ‘5 Steps to the Bridge Exercise’ taught by Physical Therapist Team Leader Sung Woo-kyung.

Please refer to this video and have a great day! Seong Woo-kyung’s Love for Physical Therapy

If you have any questions about the life and professional philosophy of a physical therapist,

Please refer to the book [Beyond Physical Therapy]

http://link.coupang.com/a/bXwnFn

Physical Therapist Seong Woo-kyung

Team Leader, Rehabilitation Center, Namgise Hospital

It is said that humans experience aging twice in their lives.

The first stage of aging begins in the mid-30s, and the second begins in the 60s!

So, if you are approaching 60, you need to start preparing in advance right now.

en-US.title: My face keeps turning red... Facial flushing? Seborrheic dermatitis? Rosacea? How to distinguish ...
en-US.description:
Those whose faces frequently turn red often dismiss it lightly, thinking, "That’s just my constitution."

In particular, facial flushing, seborrheic dermatitis, and rosacea are frequently confused with each other.

I will explain the characteristics and differences of these three conditions, as well as the symptoms that appear when they become chronic.

Many people are unaware that if facial flushing is taken lightly and left untreated, it can progress to rosacea or seborrheic dermatitis.

They look similar on the surface, which can cause confusion.

It is truly important to accurately understand the differences between each condition and how to address them.

Dr. Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Dr. Jung Dae-woong, who overcame severe atopic dermatitis, explain:

‘Differences between Facial Flushing, Seborrheic Dermatitis, and Rosacea, and the Risks of Chronicization.’

Please refer to this video and achieve beautiful, healthy skin! Park Chi-young and Jung Dae-woong's Skin Talk (Uploaded every Thursday at 7 AM)

- Director Park Chi-young and Director Jung Dae-woong of Saengki Korean Medicine Clinic

Saengki Korean Medicine Clinic http://www.saengki.com/

en-US.title: Why Do Skin Diseases Occur Particularly on the Face? Characteristics of Facial Skin and Customize...
en-US.description:
Acne, facial flushing, atopic dermatitis, seborrheic dermatitis, rosacea, folliculitis, allergies, and more.

Compared to other parts of the body, a wide variety of skin conditions occur on the face.

I will share the characteristics of facial skin and special customized care methods.

The skin barrier on the face is incomparably thinner than that of other areas.

It is rich in blood vessels and sebaceous glands, and with its developed sensory nerves,

it is the area most exposed to ultraviolet rays and environmental stimuli.

Once you understand these characteristics, you will understand why skin problems are particularly prevalent on the face and why more meticulous care is required.

Here are some ‘special facial skin care tips’ shared by Dr. Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Dr. Jung Dae-woong, who overcame severe atopic dermatitis.

Please refer to this video and create beautiful, healthy skin! Park Chi-young and Jung Dae-woong's Skin Talk (Uploaded every Thursday at 7 AM)

- Director Park Chi-young and Director Jung Dae-woong of Saengki Korean Medicine Clinic

en-US.title: Does doing back exercises incorrectly make it hurt more? Customized exercise methods to drastical...
en-US.description:
If you perform exercises targeting the lumbar spine to resolve back pain,

there is a risk that the pain will actually worsen as it directs all nerve signals to the lumbar region.

I will share customized exercise methods that do not strain your back.

Since the lower back is the central axis of our body and a key area responsible for stability and movement,

if your back is uncomfortable, your activity level decreases and muscles weaken, leading to a decline in life satisfaction.

So, what kind of exercises can healthily resolve back pain?

The answer lies in exercising while ensuring the movement of the thoracic spine and the stability of the lumbar spine.

Please refer to this video on ‘Back Exercises Without Straining the Back,’ taught by Physical Therapist Team Leader Sung Woo-kyung,

snippet.title: 영화 ‘왕과 사는 남자’ 속 세조가 왕위 찬탈 이후 지독한 ‘이것’에 시달린 이유? - 박치영, 정대웅의 피부 톡톡 #222
snippet.description:
요즘 극장가에는 1500만 관객을 동원한 ‘왕과 사는 남자’가 큰 화제입니다
영화는 숙부인 세조에게 왕위를 빼앗긴 단종의 마지막을 다루고 있는데요
오늘은 역사적 사실을 바탕으로 조선의 임금들이 고생한 ‘이것’에 대해 알려드릴게요

실제로 조선왕조실록을 보면 세조의 피부병 기록이 꽤 자세하게 나옵니다
세조는 전신의 피부에 염증이 발생하고 극심한 가려움증을 호소했으며
치료를 위해 전국의 온천을 순행했다는 기록이 있습니다
민간에서는 단종에 대한 죄책감 때문이라고 했지만

en-US.title: Why did Sejo in the movie 'The Man Who Lives with the King' suffer from this terrible 'thing' aft...
en-US.description:
These days, the movie *The Man Who Lives with Kings*, which has drawn 15 million viewers, is a major topic of conversation in theaters.

The film depicts the final days of King Danjong, who was deprived of the throne by his uncle, Sejo.

Today, based on historical facts, I will tell you about "this" that the kings of Joseon suffered from.

In fact, if you look at the Annals of the Joseon Dynasty, there are quite detailed records of King Sejo's skin disease.

There are records stating that Sejo suffered from inflammation on his entire body and complained of severe itching, and that he toured hot springs throughout the country for treatment.

While the common people attributed it to guilt over Danjong, there was actually a much more realistic reason.

It was not just Sejo; from King Sejong the Great to Yeongjo, Jeongjo, and Sukjong,

as many as 12 out of the 27 kings of Joseon suffered from skin diseases.

As the king of a nation, one would expect him to have received the best treatment in the best medical environments, more so than anyone else.

So, what was the reason the kings of Joseon suffered from skin diseases? Director Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Director Jung Dae-woong, who overcame severe atopic dermatitis, share

‘Stories of Skin Diseases Among Joseon Kings’

Refer to this video and achieve beautiful, healthy skin!

Park Chi-young & Jung Dae-woong’s Skin Talk (Uploaded every Thursday at 7 AM)

- Director Park Chi-young & Jung Dae-woong, Saengki Korean Medicine Clinic

en-US.title: If You Want to Solve Your Spring Skin Concerns, Eat ‘This’ Instead of Coffee! - Park Chi-young, J...
en-US.description:
Many people struggle with acne or skin troubles as soon as spring arrives.

However, there is a more significant cause than the commonly thought-of yellow dust or fine dust.

I will share the changes that occur in the skin during the spring and some super simple care tips.

Spring acne can be attributed more to changes in our body's metabolism than to fine dust.

When metabolic waste accumulated throughout the winter meets the rapid hormonal changes of spring,

an explosive reaction occurs in the skin.

Dr. Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Dr. Jung Dae-woong, who overcame severe atopic dermatitis, share their ‘Spring Skin Trouble Management Tips.’

Please refer to this video and achieve beautiful, healthy skin! Park Chi-young and Jung Dae-woong's Skin Talk (Uploaded every Thursday at 7 AM)

en-US.title: Muscle Mass Increased by 8% After Consistently Doing ‘This Exercise’? The 2 Best Exercise Methods...
en-US.description:
Statistics show that one in three seniors aged 60 or older suffers from sarcopenia.

Weakened muscles are dangerous because they make walking difficult and cause falls even from minor impacts.

I will tell you about the causes, major symptoms, and preventive exercise methods for sarcopenia!

Sarcopenia refers to a condition where muscle mass, strength, and physical fitness decrease with age.

This increases the risk of falls and fractures, as well as chronic diseases such as diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases.

As we age, muscle mass naturally decreases, recovery speeds slow, and muscles become more prone to weakening.

However, age may not be the only factor.

en-US.title: The more moisturizer you apply in the spring, the more your skin breaks out? The betrayal of the ...
en-US.description:
You may expect your skin condition to improve slightly as winter passes and spring arrives, but instead, your face often becomes redder and feels hotter.

In particular, the more you reapply moisturizer because your skin feels dry and tight, the worse your condition becomes.

Many people ask, "It's spring, so why is my skin so itchy and stinging?"

It is certainly less dry than in winter.

In fact, the core of spring skin troubles is not "dryness" itself,

but a complex issue created by two environmental factors: extreme daily temperature fluctuations and fine dust.

Moisturizers can become poison if you choose the wrong timing and method.

Dr. Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Dr. Jung Dae-woong, who overcame severe atopic dermatitis, share

"Precautions for Using Moisturizers in Spring."

Please refer to this video and achieve beautiful, healthy skin! Park Chi-young and Jung Dae-woong's Skin Talk (Uploaded every Thursday at 7 AM)

- Director Park Chi-young and Director Jung Dae-woong of Saengki Korean Medicine Clinic

en-US.title: Treating Skin with Poison? The Amazing Effects of Bee Venom and Snake Venom Treatment, Eliminatin...
en-US.description:
Have you ever heard of treating warts and athlete's foot with venom?
It might seem a bit absurd to use terrifying venoms like snake and bee venom for skin treatments,
but venom therapy is a practice that has been practiced in Oriental medicine for thousands of years.

What's even more surprising is that modern science has recently proven its effectiveness.
While venom treatments may seem somewhat risky,
the actual results show that they are both safe and effective.
We often see cases where warts that were previously resistant to cryosurgery or laser removal disappear without a trace.
And for those who have developed resistance to antifungal medications, venom therapy is often helpful.

Director Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Director Jeong Dae-woong, a veteran of severe atopic dermatitis, share their insights on bee and snake venom treatments.
Watch this video to achieve beautiful, healthy skin!

en-US.title: Is frozen shoulder just a sign of age? If you want healthy shoulders, start these exercises right...
en-US.description:
For those who experience shoulder or arm pain and wake up at night with discomfort, especially "frozen shoulder," a common condition that often brings them to the hospital, try these three exercises to prevent it early!

Frozen shoulder is medically known as "adhesive capsulitis," and it's a condition where the joint capsule becomes inflamed and stiff, reducing range of motion. Pain isn't limited to the shoulder, but often extends to the deltoid muscle. Initially, the inflammation causes severe pain at night, making it difficult to raise or bend the arm backward. While the discomfort may lessen during the freezing phase, functional limitations remain. Daily tasks like buttoning a shirt or combing hair become difficult.

Physical therapist Sung Woo-kyung shares her "frozen shoulder prevention exercises."
Refer to this video and keep fighting!

Sung Woo-kyung's Love of Physical Therapy

If you have any questions about the life and professional philosophy of a physical therapist, please refer to the book [Beyond Physical Therapy]
http://link.coupang.com/a/bXwnFn

Sung Woo-kyung, Physiotherapist
Namgi Se Hospital Rehabilitation Center Team Leader

en-US.description:
A stroke suddenly struck!?
Stroke doesn't strike suddenly.
It's a disease that gradually builds up over time, eventually exploding.

Lifestyle habits we often overlook can damage cerebral blood vessels and even lead to stroke.

What exactly are these brain-damaging habits?
And can we prevent strokes by changing them?

Professor Lee Seung-hoon of Seoul National University Hospital, the "National Brain Health Doctor," shares tips on how to practice brain health.
Build a healthy brain free from stroke with Kokodok right now!

If you found this video helpful, please subscribe, like, and turn on notifications. It's a huge help.

en-US.title: Psoriasis? Atopic dermatitis? Seborrheic dermatitis? Not all of them! It could be "porous rosacea...
en-US.description:
Many patients I see in my clinic struggle to receive an accurate diagnosis, initially struggling to find a cure and having to visit multiple hospitals.
I'll explain the true nature of this common skin condition and its often misunderstood nature!

According to UK statistics, approximately 1 in 5,000 patients visiting a clinic for skin conditions are diagnosed with pityriasis versicolor.
Because it's so rare, accurate diagnosis is often difficult for medical institutions.
Many patients are misdiagnosed with common conditions like psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, or seborrheic dermatitis,
leading to missed opportunities for appropriate treatment.
This is "Pityriasis versicolor."
The physical and psychological pain experienced by patients is immense.

Director Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin conditions, and Director Jeong Dae-woong, a veteran of severe atopic dermatitis, explain "Pityriasis versicolor."
Refer to this video to achieve beautiful, healthy skin!

Park Chi-young and Jung Dae-woong's Skin Talk (Uploaded every Thursday at 7 AM)

Have you heard the saying, "Your skin is a mirror of your gut health"?
Recent research shows this isn't just a myth, but rather a scientifically sound one.
I'll explain the connection between the gut and skin, along with practical treatment examples.

At first glance, the gut and skin may seem completely different organs, but they are actually both massive immune systems that directly interact with the external environment. The vast community of microorganisms that inhabit the gut not only plays a role in digestion, but also regulates our entire immune system.

en-US.title: Feeling dizzy and lightheaded when you suddenly stand up? 4 Exercises to Prevent Orthostatic Hypo...
en-US.description:
Have you ever felt dizzy and lightheaded when you suddenly stand up after sitting or lying down for a long time? I'll explain everything about orthostatic hypotension, from its symptoms and causes to exercises.

Orthostatic hypotension occurs when you suddenly stand up from a sitting or lying position. This causes your autonomic nervous system to malfunction, lowering your blood pressure and causing symptoms like blurred vision and dizziness.
Many people often think orthostatic hypotension only causes dizziness, but symptoms like dizziness, pale face, general fatigue, lethargy, and headaches can also occur.

To prevent orthostatic hypotension, avoid strenuous exercise and engage in regular, moderate exercise.
In particular, strengthening lower body muscles, such as the thighs and calves, is crucial to improve blood flow to the heart and brain.

Physical therapist Sung Woo-kyung shares her tips for preventing orthostatic hypotension.
Refer to this video and keep up the good work!

Sung Woo-kyung's Love of Physical Therapy

If you have any questions about the life and professional philosophy of a physical therapist,
please refer to the book [Beyond Physical Therapy]

en-US.title: If your face is red and tingling, you should also pay attention to your gut health! The Link Betw...
en-US.description:
Rosacea dermatitis is a condition characterized by redness, itchiness, and stinging, primarily in the central part of the face. Research has shown that treating the intestines, rather than the facial skin, can improve rosacea dermatitis. Discover the surprising connection between rosacea dermatitis and gut health!

Rosacea dermatitis is a chronic inflammatory skin condition characterized by erythema, primarily in the central part of the face. It's characterized by frequent relapses. It's not simply a skin problem; it may be deeply linked to gut health. Research has shown that treating the intestines can lead to long-term symptom improvement. Dr. Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Dr. Jeong Dae-woong, a veteran of severe atopic dermatitis, share their insights on "The Amazing Link Between Rosacea Dermatitis and Gut Health." Watch this video to achieve beautiful, healthy skin!

snippet.description:

en-US.title: The Surprising Link Between Atopic Dermatitis and Weight! Effective Weight Management Methods for...
en-US.description:
People with atopic dermatitis often worry about weight fluctuations.
Sometimes they lose weight, while others experience a bulging belly.
I'll explain the surprising relationship between atopic dermatitis and weight.

Surprisingly, atopic dermatitis can have a two-way effect on weight. In some cases, it can lead to weight loss, while in others, it can lead to obesity.
Obesity is particularly problematic for adults with atopic dermatitis.
Obesity is not simply a comorbidity,
but it's been identified as a risk factor that worsens atopic dermatitis and increases treatment resistance.
However, extreme dieting can actually weaken the immune system and worsen atopic dermatitis.

Director Park Chi-young, a specialist in intractable skin diseases, and Director Jeong Dae-woong, a veteran of severe atopic dermatitis, share their insights on "The Surprising Relationship Between Atopic Dermatitis and Weight."
Watch this video to achieve beautiful, healthy skin!

en-US.title: Could I Have "Lost Hip Syndrome"? Two Surefire Ways to Revive Dead Hip Muscles - Sung Woo-kyung's...
en-US.description:
Have you heard of "hip amnesia" or "hip loss syndrome"?
The names may be unfamiliar, but they're emerging as a common condition for modern people who spend long hours sitting.
So, how can we restore lost hip muscles?

"Hip loss syndrome" refers to the weakening of the hip muscles due to lack of proper use.

Because the hip muscles are located in the center of the body,
their weakening can limit movement, leading to pain and imbalances.
This can lead to back pain, pelvic imbalances, and fatigue in the hips and legs.

Physical therapist Sung Woo-kyung shares her tips for overcoming "hip loss syndrome."

Watch this video and keep up the good work!

그것만큼 행복하고 완벽한 인생이 또 있을까?

죽음을 앞두고 깨달은 삶의 진실을
세상과 나누는 모리 교수의 이야기

오늘 하루하루를 잘 살아감으로써
결국 좋은 삶이 되고
그 끝은 좋은 죽음이 되는 것

삶과 죽음에 대해 진지하게 생각해 보는 시간
꼬꼬독과 함께 하세요
